title: Just ok, but better than some
text: Just ok, but better than some. I really like these for storage, but I consider them semi-disposable. They do not do well over time, melt when over-heated in the microwave and disfigure if left on the bottom rack of dishwasher. So with extra care, they are better than the store bought storage and do much better in the freezer, but don't plan to keep them forever.
